method: Per-target-anchor differentiable entity-node masks using the selected current SSL-GGL checkpoint
mask_scope: intrusion, carbonate, and contact entity node features; anchor features and graph structure unchanged
hard_constraints: held at observed values through model_forward(hard=True); no mask optimized for hard-constraint channels
loss: squared target-logit fidelity + mean-mask sparsity + 0.1 * mask entropy
plot_rule: average entity masks across target-union anchors; top 25% within each entity type; rank all features by absolute median input contrast
limitation: Model sensitivity under entity-feature suppression, not geological causation.
